meta.source: Created from scratch for Wazn (وزن), Nov 2026.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background (Wazn Ivory / Night). Default ground for text and charts.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, inputs: one step above surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: table header rows, zebra rows, code blocks, track of weight bars.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the mark's weights. 15.6:1 on surface-0 (light), 15:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, axis ticks. 5.8:1 on surface-0, 5.2:1 on surface-2.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand blocks and primary buttons (Wazn Ink). In dark it lifts to navy so blocks never vanish into the ground.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Secondary brand block, hover state of brand-ink surfaces, chart series 2.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Wazn Brass: the beam and fulcrum, accent fills, active weight bars, focus of attention. Fills and 24px+ type only (3.1:1 on surface-0); never body text.

tokens.name: brass-text
tokens.usage: Brass when it must be read: links, small accent labels, focus rings. 5.7:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: brass-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brass ground: selected rows, highlighted figures, callouts.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-ink, brand-navy. 15.6:1 / 7.4:1.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on brass fills (accent buttons). 5.0:1 / 7.9:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, card borders (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). 3.6:1 on surface-1, meets 3:1 non-text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, compliant (متوافق), filled orders. Always paired with ▲ or a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for positive badges and gain highlights. positive text 7.0:1 on it.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, excluded (مستبعد), rejected orders. Lighter than positive in light theme, darker in dark: tellable by lightness, plus ▼.

tokens.name: negative-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for negative badges. negative text 4.9:1 on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Watchlist (تحت المراقبة), stale data, pending reconciliation.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges. warning text 5.0:1 on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, 2px offset) on every interactive element.

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines, cover names. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text. 1.75 leading keeps Arabic diacritics and dots clear.
styles.sample: الـ AI بيقترح، والقواعد بتقرر، وأنت بتوافق.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Prices, weights, quantities in tables. Tabular, right-aligned.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Use the steps; never in-between values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls; table cell padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding inline; table cell padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); gap between related fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default); gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections; logo clear space at 48px mark height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop, cover insets.

radius.note: Precise, square-shouldered. Small radii only: Wazn is a ledger, not a toy.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, weight bars, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, app icon corners at small sizes, cover blocks.

shadow.note: Borders before shadows. One shadow, for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the approval sheet. Never on cards in a grid.
